user.title: Add a compost bin
user.description:
Tell Smart Compost Manager about your compost bin.

Physical sensors are **optional**: the coach works without them, using your materials, observations and interventions. Sensors can be connected later.

data_description.name: How you call this compost bin.
data_description.compost_type: The kind of container or pile you use.
data_description.method: Keep adding material to the same bin (continuous), or manage separate batches (batch).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Where does this compost bin live? Defaults are safe: unknown values stay **unknown** and are never guessed.

data_description.shelter: How protected the bin is from the weather.
data_description.rain_exposure: How much rain reaches the material.
data_description.sun_exposure: How much direct sun the bin gets.

init.title: Sensors
init.description: Optionally bind sensors that already exist in Home Assistant. Smart Compost Manager only reads them — it never creates physical sensor copies — and stops using them when they become stale or unavailable.

data_description.temperature_entity: Must measure inside the compost pile, not the ambient air.
data_description.moisture_entity: Must measure moisture inside the compost material.
data_description.voc_entity: Optional gas sensor in a concentration unit (ppb, ppm or µg/m³). An index or unknown scale supports no conclusion.
data_description.ammonia_entity: Optional ammonia sensor in a concentration unit (ppb, ppm or µg/m³). Used only to corroborate a nitrogen excess.
data_description.fill_entity: Optional fill sensor reporting percent of capacity (%). Used only to corroborate that the bin is nearly full.
data_description.notification_categories: Which notifications Home Assistant shows as persistent notifications for this bin. Events are always fired on the event bus for your own automations.

error.same_sensor: The same physical sensor cannot feed more than one input: bind each sensor to exactly one measurement.

log_material.name: Log material addition
log_material.description: Record material added to a compost bin; the assessment is recalculated immediately.

device_id.name: Compost bin
device_id.description: The compost bin to log the material for.

material_type.name: Material
material_type.description: What was added, for example food_scraps, leaves, cardboard.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How much was added. Omit to log a qualitative entry instead.

quantity_unit.name: Unit
quantity_unit.description: Unit of the quantity, for example bucket, litre, kg.

quantity_precision.name: Precision
quantity_precision.description: How precise the quantity is. Defaults to approximate when a quantity is given, qualitative otherwise.

log_observation.name: Log observation
log_observation.description: Record something you noticed at the bin: moisture, odor, pests, structure, appearance, activity.

device_id.name: Compost bin
device_id.description: The compost bin this observation is about.

value.name: Observation
value.description: What you noticed, for example damp, sour smell, no larvae.

log_intervention.name: Log intervention
log_intervention.description: Record an action you performed (watering, turning, aeration, corrections), so later changes can be checked against it.

device_id.name: Compost bin
device_id.description: The compost bin this intervention was performed on.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long it took, in minutes.

start_cycle.name: Start cycle
start_cycle.description: Start a new batch cycle for this compost bin; the cycle report and any comparison are recalculated immediately.

device_id.name: Compost bin
device_id.description: The compost bin whose cycle should start.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-form notes about how this cycle was started.

complete_cycle.name: Complete cycle
complete_cycle.description: Complete the active batch cycle, optionally recording what it produced; the cycle report and any comparison are recalculated immediately.

device_id.name: Compost bin
device_id.description: The compost bin whose active cycle should be completed.

output_quantity.name: Output quantity
output_quantity.description: How much the cycle produced. Omit if you did not measure it.

output_unit.name: Output unit
output_unit.description: Unit of the produced quantity, for example litre, kg, bucket.

output_destination.name: Destination
output_destination.description: Where the finished compost went, for example raised_bed, garden, storage.

output_notes.name: Output notes
output_notes.description: Optional free-form notes about the produced compost.

phase_changed.title: Compost phase changed
phase_changed.message: The phase of {bin} is now {after}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

thermophilic.title: Thermophilic phase detected
thermophilic.message: The compost in {bin} is now in the thermophilic phase. Confidence: {confidence}%.

health_degraded.title: Compost health degraded
health_degraded.message: The health of {bin} dropped from {before} to {after}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

health_recovered.title: Compost health recovered
health_recovered.message: The health of {bin} improved from {before} to {after}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

rapid_heating.title: Rapid heating detected
rapid_heating.message: The compost in {bin} is heating up fast. Confidence: {confidence}%.

rapid_cooling.title: Rapid cooling detected
rapid_cooling.message: The compost in {bin} is cooling down fast. Confidence: {confidence}%.

moisture_too_dry.title: Compost may be too dry
moisture_too_dry.message: The internal moisture of {bin} reads too low. Suggested action: {action}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

moisture_too_wet.title: Compost may be too wet
moisture_too_wet.message: The internal moisture of {bin} reads too high. Suggested action: {action}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

aeration.title: Possible aeration issue
aeration.message: Observed signals at {bin} suggest poor aeration. Suggested action: {action}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

balance_greens.title: Possible material imbalance
balance_greens.message: {bin} has too much green material relative to dry browns. Suggested action: {action}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

balance_browns.title: Possible material imbalance
balance_browns.message: {bin} has too much dry brown material relative to greens. Suggested action: {action}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

cycle_started.title: New compost cycle
cycle_started.message: A new cycle started at {bin}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

cycle_completed.title: Compost cycle completed
cycle_completed.message: The active cycle of {bin} is complete. Confidence: {confidence}%.

maturity_estimated.title: Compost maturity updated
maturity_estimated.message: The compost of {bin} is now {after}. Confidence: {confidence}%.

sensor_unavailable.title: Temperature sensor unavailable
sensor_unavailable.message: The temperature sensor of {bin} stopped reporting. Conclusions fall back to UNKNOWN until it returns.

sensor_restored.title: Temperature sensor restored
sensor_restored.message: The temperature sensor of {bin} is reporting again.

resolved.title: Issue resolved
resolved.message: The {category} issue at {bin} is no longer detected. Confidence: {confidence}%.

state.improve_aeration: Turn the compost to improve aeration

invalid_entry_data.message: The stored configuration of this compost bin is invalid. Remove the bin and add it again.

bin_not_found.message: Device {device_id} is not a configured Smart Compost Manager bin.

bin_not_loaded.message: The compost bin {device_id} is not loaded yet. Try again once Home Assistant has finished starting up.

cycle_already_active.message: Compost bin {bin_id} already has an active cycle. Complete it before starting a new one.

no_active_cycle.message: Compost bin {bin_id} has no active cycle to complete.
